parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ snippet: { title: ($json.title || '').substring(0, 100), description: ($json.description || '') + '\n\n#Shorts', tags: (() => { try { return JSON.parse($json.hashtags || '[]').map(h => String(h).replace('#', '')); } catch(e) { return []; } })() }, status: { privacyStatus: 'private' } }) }}

nodes.name: Scanner Trigger
nodes.notes: Layer-1 ToS coarse poll: every 8h. Layer-2 cap (<=3/day) lives in 'TikTok Rate Limit' Code node.

nodes.name: TikTok Rate Limit
nodes.notes: Layer-2 ToS cap: <=3 posts/day, UTC-day-scoped via workflow static data. Layer-1 is the Scanner Trigger cron (0 */8 * * *).

nodes.name: TikTok Sidecar Upload
nodes.notes: POSTs the clip + caption + hashtags to the in-cluster FastAPI sidecar (wraps makiisthenes/TiktokAutoUploader, cookie-auth). Replaces the 3 deleted TikTok Open API nodes (Init/Upload/Poll). Service URL: tiktok-sidecar.n8n-live.svc.cluster.local:8000
